    free_before = max(1.0 - cpu_before, 0.02)

    pressure = cpu_util / cpu_free
    pressure_before = cpu_before / free_before
    pressure_increase = max(pressure - pressure_before, 0.0)
    queue_cost = (18.0 * cpu_util + 48.0 * request_util) / cpu_free
    queue_cost = queue_cost + 12.0 * pressure_increase
    memory_cost = 3.0 * mem_util / mem_free

    cpu_excess = max(cpu_util - 0.72, 0.0)
    mem_excess = max(mem_util - 0.85, 0.0)
    burst_cost = 160.0 * cpu_excess * cpu_excess / cpu_free
    burst_cost = burst_cost + 60.0 * mem_excess * mem_excess / mem_free

    latency_peak: float = 0.0
    edge_count: float = 0.0
    for e in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        source = ctx.pods[ctx.graph.src[e]]
        destination = ctx.pods[ctx.graph.dst[e]]

        elif destination.service == pod.service and destination.app == pod.app:

    wake_cost: float = 0.0

    energy_weight = 0.12 / (1.0 + cpu_excess / cpu_free + mem_excess / mem_free)
